title: Warrior Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Academy

services.name: Kids Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: The Warrior BJJ Academy’s Kids Program is the perfect way for your child to mature into an adult while learning the most effective martial art in the world. We focus on teaching a hard work ethic, a positive attitude, and a love for the Jiu Jitsu life style. It is also a great way of getting in shape, making friends, and having fun. Classes include techniques, physical drills, games, and live sparring. Our classes range from 30-45 minutes long depending on the age group. We don’t require a long term commitment, and we offer a free trial class so your kids can try out the class before signing them up! services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Come join our excellent instructors for action-packed excitement in our annual Summer Camp! Our Summer Camp is the perfect activity to keep your kids engaged in their training while building life-long friendships and experiences. For those with little or no martial arts experience, Summer Camp is a great opportunity to get acquainted with our school, our staff, and fundamental self-defense techniques and jumpstart your kids’ training. Existing students will gain valuable skills such as leadership, teamwork, communication, and respect.
